story_position: Chapter 3 — Beat 13 — Return to Mirena / Cresthaven Identified
hard_outcomes: The party reports recent-reader, Hall-of-Seals and Sealwright findings without resolving the seal mystery.
The party presents the approximately 500-year-old Yahtrean Westways recordbook map copy.
Ancient-capital existence at Caelora is treated as already known; the new information is intact scale, route relationship and the giant northern tower.
Mirena identifies the tower's modern geographic location as Cresthaven, the old abandoned fort.
The tower's Ancient name/function and northbound destination remain unknown.
Rest occurs offscreen and Mirena/Maevra plan to meet the party at Cresthaven the next morning.
